section.div: A modern anime streaming and discovery platform built with Next.js, TypeScript, and multiple anime data sources.

EliasDex Next is a modern anime and manga streaming web app built with Next.js. It combines browsing, search, content detail pages, user authentication, progress tracking, donations, and leaderboard features in a polished UI. Online anime streaming at eliasdex with DUB, SUB in HD eliasdex, Anix, 9anime, Zoro, Animixplay.
Feature-rich WhatsApp bot powered by @whiskeysockets/baileys and lowdb. Packed with interactive mini-games, gacha waifu system with trading mechanics, media tools, and automated group management.
